name: Foundation
movement_competency: Learning basic shapes: squat, hinge, lunge, push, pull, brace, land. Needs demo and cues on most reps. Knees cave or trunk folds when tired.
strength_training_experience: None, or under ~3 months of supervised training. Body weight only.
sport_skill_competency: Inconsistent grip, footwork and catch-throw sequence. Cannot repeat a delivery or swing pattern 3 times in a row.
workload_tolerance: Short sessions (20-40 min). Form fades quickly. Needs frequent rest.
technical_understanding: Follows one simple cue at a time. Cannot yet describe what changed.
independence: Needs a coach present for every block. Not ready for home work without a guardian.

name: Developing
movement_competency: Holds good shapes on most reps at body weight. Lands quietly with knees over toes. Can hold a 30 s plank with a neutral spine.
strength_training_experience: About 3-12 months supervised. Light implements (bands, light DB/KB) with good form.
sport_skill_competency: Repeats basic mechanics on most reps at Easy/Moderate intent. Breaks down at Firm intent or under game speed.
workload_tolerance: Handles full team sessions. Needs planned easy days after games.
technical_understanding: Understands 2-3 cues. Can tell the coach when a rep felt wrong.
independence: Completes a familiar warm-up and arm-care routine with light supervision.

name: Advanced
movement_competency: Owns fundamental patterns under light-to-moderate load and at speed. Decelerates and changes direction under control.
strength_training_experience: 1-3 years of consistent supervised training. Ready for moderate loads with technique checks.
sport_skill_competency: Mechanics hold at Firm intent and in live reps. Position skills are game-ready at their level.
workload_tolerance: Tolerates a planned weekly structure across practice, games and training when recovery days are respected.
technical_understanding: Self-corrects with one cue. Understands why a drill is used.
independence: Runs own warm-up and arm care. Logs completion honestly. Follows the plan without reminders.

name: Elite
movement_competency: Consistent, efficient movement under moderate load, at full speed and when fatigued.
strength_training_experience: 3+ years of structured training. Supervised low-rep work is allowed only per P04 §3.1 (training age 1_3yr+, 15U-17U).
sport_skill_competency: Repeatable, adjustable mechanics. Makes in-game adjustments.
workload_tolerance: Highest planned volume inside the same age-band ceilings. Level never raises a ceiling.
technical_understanding: Explains own mechanics and plan. Gives useful feedback to coaches.
independence: Largely self-directed inside the plan. Still subject to every check-in and pause rule.

name: Off-season
strength: Highest emphasis. 2-3 sessions/wk (3rd = admin, per cap_both-strength-*). Build technique, then volume, then load.
throwing: Starts with planned time off from throwing (Pitch Smart: at least 4 months/yr total without competitive throwing). Then a gradual return at Easy/Moderate intent. No max-intent throwing early.
arm_care: 3-4 days/wk. Full routine ARM-RTN-01 and ARM-RTN-03.
skill: High technical volume at low intensity: dry work, tee, short-distance drills.

name: Preseason
strength: 2 sessions/wk. Keep the load, reduce total sets ~20-30%. Shift toward power and speed.
throwing: Ramp-up (THR-BB-PRE-01 / THR-SB-POS-01): intent and distance build week to week. Pitchers add mound work per program.
arm_care: Before every throwing day (ARM-RTN-01), after it (ARM-RTN-02).
skill: Moves from blocked to random/live reps. Game situations added.
speed_power: Sprint and acceleration quality emphasized, full rest.

name: Early season
maps_to: ssp_preseason or ssp_in-season (no ssp_early-season exists; admin may add one, AC-15)
strength: 1-2 sessions/wk. Maintain. Drop 1 set if games are stacked.
throwing: Game workloads begin. Bullpens/long toss reduced to maintenance. Recovery days are enforced.
arm_care: Every throwing day, plus post-game recovery.
skill: Short, focused sessions targeting game needs.
speed_power: Low volume, high quality. No plyometric block on game days.

name: Competition season
strength: 1-2 short sessions/wk (P04 A-7 note: 1 session in tournament or heavy weeks; deload = drop 1 set).
throwing: Maintenance only (THR-BB-INS-01). Game throws count toward the one throwing total. Rest days follow approved ceilings.
skill: Lowest volume. Sharpening and situational work.
speed_power: Primers only (2-4 short accelerations) on non-game days.

name: Postseason / recovery
strength: Light general activity, mobility, other sports and play. Retest movement quality only if the coach chooses.
throwing: Planned break from throwing (counts toward the annual time away).
skill: Optional fun and multi-sport play. No structured volume.

name: Prospects intent scale (named intensity scale required by handoff C4)

levels.label: Easy
levels.description: About half effort. Smooth, relaxed, can talk normally.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.description: About 70%. Controlled, on a line or arc with good form.

levels.label: Firm
levels.description: About 85%. Strong but still repeatable. Counts as high-intensity for throwing.

levels.label: Game
levels.description: Full game intent. Counts as high-intensity. Allowed only where a program phase says so.

rule: Firm and Game throws count toward cap_*-nonpitch-high-intensity-throws-day-<band> as well as the total.

name: Throwing stopping rules (all throwing, arm-care and pitching records)
rules: Any pain, or 'yes' to 'Does your throwing arm hurt?': stop all throwing at once. Show the CB-2 stop-and-tell text. A full pause follows the D11 release rules.
Mechanics break down (arm drops, front side flies open, misses on consecutive throws by more than a body width): end that block. Finish with Easy throws only if form returns at once, otherwise stop.
Visible fatigue (slower arm, rushed tempo, athlete says tired): stop the throwing block. Record a check-in if the athlete reports 'high'.
No warm-up completed: no throwing above Easy.
Never 'throw through it'. No extra throws to make up a missed day (no make-up prompts, D8).
Health questions go to the parent/guardian and a licensed healthcare provider. Coaches do not diagnose or treat.

name: Standard throwing warm-up sequence (before any throwing)
sequence: General raise 3-5 min: jog, skips, carioca (ARM-DWU-01..04)
Throwing progression (no-ball counts false): wrist flick -> one-knee -> step-behind -> catch play, Easy to Moderate

name: Movement Foundations (Play-Based)
frequency: 2x/wk, non-consecutive days, 25-35 min
description: Builds basic movement skills through games and simple bodyweight patterns. Not a workout program.
progression_rules: Add the 2nd set only when every rep of the 1st set looks good. Then add 2 reps. Never add external load in this band.
regression: Squat to a box/bench; push-up on a higher surface; bridge with shorter hold; jumps become hops in place.
coach_notes: Make it a game. Count good reps, not total reps. Watch knees over toes on landings and a flat back on squats. Stop the block when form fades.
athlete_notes: Move well, land quietly, have fun. If something hurts, stop and tell your coach and your parent.

name: Athletic Foundations 11U-12U
frequency: 2x/wk (3rd only with admin approval), 35-45 min
description: Teaches squat, hinge, lunge, push, pull, brace, carry and land, plus acceleration and deceleration basics.
session_structure: Dynamic warm-up 8 min (RULE-WU-01 first two parts)
progression_rules: Technique first. Progress one variable at a time: reps (to 15), then sets (to 3), then a light implement only after the coach signs off technique. Plyometric contacts stay ≤60/session; sprints ≤12/session.
regression: Box squat; hands-elevated push-up; split squat holding a rail; replace band row with towel row.
coach_notes: Off-season 2x/wk. In-season 1x/wk at the same exercises, 1 set each. No sprint or jump block on game days.
athlete_notes: Do every rep with good form. Stop well before you can't do more. Tell your coach if anything hurts.

name: Strength & Speed Development 13U-14U
frequency: Off/pre 2x/wk (3rd = admin), 45-50 min; in-season 1x/wk, 25-30 min
description: Adds light-to-moderate loads, med-ball power and change of direction, with coach-checked technique and growth-spurt awareness.
progression_rules: Load rises only after 2 sessions in a row with clean reps at the top of the rep range. Keep 3+ good reps in reserve. Plyo ≤80-100 contacts/session (upper band = admin); sprints ≤15 per session.
regression: Remove the load (back to STR-INT-01 patterns). During rapid growth, coach may cut jump volume by half and swap bounds for snap-downs.
coach_notes: Expect awkward phases during growth. Re-teach technique instead of adding load. In-season: one session, 1-2 sets, no new exercises.
athlete_notes: Strong reps, not heavy reps. Finish every set knowing you could do 3 more good ones.

name: High School Development 15U-17U
frequency: Off 2-3x/wk (3rd = admin), 50-60 min; pre 2x; in-season 1-2x, 30 min
description: For high-school athletes with under 1 year of structured training. Builds a full-body base with moderate load and sport-specific power.
progression_rules: Rep range 6-12. Add load 2-5% when all sets hit the top of the range with clean form. Deload every 4th week (drop 1 set). No reps under 6 at this level.
regression: Goblet box squat; DB deadlift from blocks; push-up instead of DB bench.
coach_notes: Teach each lift before loading it. Coordinate with school/HS team lifting so the athlete is not doubling sessions.
athlete_notes: Log your sets. Quality over load. Tell your coach about any other team's lifting so we do not double up.

name: Advanced High School Strength & Power 15U-17U
frequency: Off 3x/wk (admin-approved), 60 min; pre 2x; in-season 1-2x, 30-35 min
description: For athletes with 1-3+ years of training age (training_age_assumption 1_3yr+). Moderate loads, supervised lower-rep strength, rotational power, deceleration and durability.
items: 4-6 (3-5 only with training age 1_3yr+ and supervision)
progression_rules: Wave load across 3 weeks, then deload in week 4. Main-lift reps 4-6, or 3-5 only with logged training age and qualified supervision. In-season: keep 1-2 working sets at the same load. No new exercises in-season.
regression: Fall back to STR-HS-01 for any lift that loses form. Swap chin-ups for inverted rows. Remove the Nordic for anyone new to it.
coach_notes: Training age must be recorded before assigning. Depth/drop jumps are not included (they need admin approval per P04 §3.2). Pitchers: no heavy pressing or chin-ups within 24 h before a scheduled outing.
athlete_notes: Warm up fully. Lift with a coach watching. Never test a max. Rest days are part of the plan.

name: Med-ball chest pass to wall
instructions: Athletic stance 2-3 m from a wall. Ball at chest. Push explosively; catch on the rebound and reset.
progression: Step into the throw; heavier ball within band
common_errors: Arms only, no leg drive; flaring elbows

name: Med-ball rotational scoop toss
instructions: Side-on to the wall. Load the back hip, rotate through hips then trunk, and release at hip height. Both sides.
cues: Hips first; chest follows; let the ball go

name: Broad jump and stick
instructions: Swing the arms, jump forward, and land on both feet softly. Hold the landing for 2 s.
progression: Add a second jump after the stick
cues: Land quiet; knees over toes; chest proud

name: Lateral bound and stick
instructions: Push sideways off one leg and land on the other. Hold 2 s and repeat back.
cues: Stick it; hip back; knee over middle toe

name: Box jump (step down)
instructions: Jump onto a low box with a soft landing, stand tall, then STEP down. Never jump down.
regression: Countermovement jump on the floor, no box
common_errors: Box too high; landing in deep squat
cues: Land the way you took off

name: KB / trap-bar deadlift
instructions: Hinge with a flat back, grip, brace, and stand by pushing the floor away. Lower under control.
common_errors: Rounded back; squatting the lift; jerking the bar
cues: Long spine; push the floor; hips and shoulders rise together

name: DB bench press
instructions: Feet flat, shoulder blades set. Lower the DBs to chest level with elbows about 45°. Press up.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Hang under a bar with a straight body. Pull the chest to the bar and lower slowly.
cues: Body like a plank; shoulder blades back and down

name: Chin-up (band-assisted as needed)
instructions: Hang with palms facing you, pull until the chin is over the bar, lower for 2-3 s.

name: Single-leg RDL (DB)
instructions: Stand on one leg and hinge forward with the free leg reaching back. Return tall.
cues: Hips square; long line head to heel

name: Pallof press
instructions: Stand side-on to a band anchor. Press the band straight out and hold 2 s without rotating.

name: Suitcase carry
instructions: Carry one weight at your side and walk tall without leaning.

name: Copenhagen plank (short lever)
instructions: Side plank with the top knee on a bench and the bottom leg free. Hold.

name: Accelerate-and-stop (deceleration)
instructions: Sprint to a cone, then stop under control in 3 steps in an athletic stance. Walk back.
progression: Stop then cut 45°; react to a coach signal
common_errors: Stopping upright on one stiff leg
cues: Drop the hips; short choppy steps; chest over knees

name: Bear crawl
instructions: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, lifted 2-3 cm. Crawl forward and back with opposite hand and foot.
cues: Quiet hands and feet; flat back

name: Step-up
instructions: Whole foot on the box. Drive up through that leg and step down slowly.
common_errors: Pushing off the back foot; knee caving

name: Nordic hamstring (assisted, partial range)
instructions: Kneel with ankles held. Lower forward slowly as far as you can control, catch with your hands, push back up.
cues: Straight line knees to head; slow

name: Jog and skip build
instructions: Easy jog 2 lengths, then skips with arm swings.

name: Carioca
instructions: Move sideways crossing the trail leg in front and behind, rotating the hips.

name: Leg swings
instructions: Hold support; swing one leg front-to-back, then side-to-side.

name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Step wide, sit into one hip with the other leg straight, push back.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Bend, walk hands out to a plank, walk feet to hands.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Long lunge, inside elbow toward the instep, then rotate the arm up to the sky.
cues: Open the chest; eyes follow hand

name: Arm circles (small to large)
instructions: Arms out to the side; small circles forward, building to large; repeat backward.

name: Walking knee hug to quad pull
instructions: Walk, hug one knee to chest, step, then pull the other heel to the glute.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Arms straight at chest height; pull the band apart until it touches the chest; return slowly.

name: Band diagonal (D2) pattern
instructions: From the opposite hip, pull the band up and out diagonally like a sword draw; return slowly.

name: Wall angels / scap wall slide
instructions: Back and arms against the wall, slide arms up and down keeping contact where comfortable.

name: Quadruped shoulder taps
instructions: On hands and knees, tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without the hips shifting.
cues: Still hips; push the floor away

name: Prone Y-T-W (bodyweight)
instructions: Lying face down, lift arms into Y, then T, then W shapes, thumbs up, hold 2 s each.
cues: Shoulder blades back and down; thumbs up

name: Push-up plus
instructions: In a plank or incline, push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades, then relax them together.
cues: Arms straight; push the floor away

name: Band row
instructions: Pull the band to the ribs, shoulder blades back; return slowly.

name: Scap push-up on wall
instructions: Hands on wall, arms straight; let the chest sink between the hands, then push away.

name: Bear-position hold
instructions: Hands and feet down, knees lifted 2-3 cm, hold steady.

name: Band external rotation at side
instructions: Elbow at the side on a towel roll, bent 90°. Rotate the hand out against the band, return slowly.
common_errors: Elbow leaves the side; trunk rotates

name: Band internal rotation at side
instructions: Same set-up facing the other way; rotate the hand in toward the belly.

name: Side-lying external rotation
instructions: Lie on the non-throwing side, elbow at the side, rotate the forearm up toward the ceiling.

name: Band ER at 90° (90/90)
instructions: Arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent 90°. Rotate up to vertical against the band, return slowly.

name: Prone T with thumb up (hold)
instructions: Face down, arm out to the side, thumb up, lift and hold.

name: Forearm ball squeeze
instructions: Squeeze a soft ball for 3 s, relax.

name: Wrist flexion/extension with light band
instructions: Forearm on the thigh, move the wrist up and down against the band slowly.

name: Pronation/supination with hammer or bat
instructions: Forearm supported, turn the palm down and up slowly.

name: Rice-bucket or towel wring
instructions: Wring a rolled towel in both directions.

name: Open-book thoracic rotation
instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent, arms together; open the top arm across to the other side and follow it with the eyes.
cues: Knees stay stacked; breathe out as you open

name: Standing thoracic rotation
instructions: Athletic stance, arms crossed; rotate the upper body each way keeping hips still.

name: Dead bug
instructions: On your back, arms up, knees at 90°. Lower opposite arm and leg slowly while the low back stays down.

name: Hip-lead hold (stride position)
instructions: From the balance point, stride and hold landing with the glove side closed and chest still back.

name: Easy walk and breathing
instructions: Walk 2-3 min with slow nose breathing.

name: Gentle cross-body shoulder stretch
instructions: Bring the throwing arm across the chest, gently support with the other hand. No forcing.

name: Light band ER/IR flush
instructions: Very light band rotations, slow, pain-free range only.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On hands and knees, round then arch the back slowly with the breath.
cues: Move one segment at a time

name: 90/90 hip switch
instructions: Seated with both knees bent at 90°, rotate both knees side to side.

name: Ankle rocks
instructions: Half-kneeling facing a wall, rock the front knee forward over the toes keeping the heel down.

name: Single-leg balance reach
instructions: Balance on one leg and reach the other foot forward, side and back.

name: Child's pose with side reach
instructions: Sit back to heels with arms long, then walk both hands to each side.

name: Pre-Throw Arm Care (8-10 min)
frequency: Before every throwing session

level_rules.LVL-FND: 1 set each, no band (use no-band regressions)

coach_notes: Never skip before throwing. Bands stay light; this is preparation, not strength work.
athlete_notes: This gets your body ready to throw. Do it every time.

name: Post-Throw Recovery (5-8 min)
frequency: After every throwing session or game
coach_notes: Light and easy. Not a treatment and not a substitute for the check-in.
athlete_notes: Cool down your arm and body after throwing.

name: Off-Day Arm Support (12-15 min)
frequency: 2 non-throwing days/wk
coach_notes: Band items count as high-intensity and stop under a fatigue-only pause.
athlete_notes: Short strength work for your shoulder, back and forearm on days you do not throw.

name: Balance-point hold
